invariants.rationale: The method returns the same list object reference after sorting in-place.
No elements are added or removed; the list is sorted in place and returned.
outputPartitions is an int parameter; in the absence of context, it may be any int, so no invariant restricts it meaningfully, but left as placeholder for meaningful expressions.
'result' is returned as a List<HoodieRecord<T>>, so this is always true.
Method always returns a (possibly empty) List, never null.
